///      \"type\": \"<string>\",             // optional, default \"task\"\n    ///      \"priority\": <int>,              // optional, default 2 (0=Critical, 4=Backlog)\n    ///      \"description\": \"<string>\",      // optional\n    ///      \"assignee\": \"<string>\",        // optional\n    ///      \"labels\": [\"<string>\", ...]    // optional\n    ///    }\n    ///\n    /// 2. dep_add_blocker: Add a blocking dependency\n    ///    {\n    ///      \"op\": \"dep_add_blocker\",\n    ///      \"id\": \"<string>\",               // required: bead being blocked\n    ///      \"blocker\": \"<string>\"          // required: bead that blocks id (must close before id)\n    ///    }\n    ///    Direction: blocker blocks id (blocker must close before id can close)\n    ///    Aliases: parent -> blocker, child -> id (deprecated but supported)\n    ///\n    /// 3. close: Close a bead\n    ///    {\n    ///      \"op\": \"close\",\n    ///      \"id\": \"<string>\",               // required: bead ID to close\n    ///      \"reason\": \"<string>\"            // optional, default \"Completed\"\n    ///    }\n    ///\n    /// Placeholder references: Use @0, @1, @2... to reference beads created earlier in the batch\n    ///\n    /// Examples:\n    ///   echo '{\"op\":\"create\",\"title\":\"Fix bug\"}' | bf batch --stdin\n    ///   echo '[{\"op\":\"dep_add_blocker\",\"id\":\"bf-task\",\"blocker\":\"bf-blocker\"}]' | bf batch --stdin\n    Batch {\n        /// JSON file containing operations\n        #[arg(long)]\n        file: Option<PathBuf>,\n\n        /// JSON string containing operations\n        #[arg(long)]\n        json: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Read from stdin\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"false\")]\n        stdin: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Mitosis: split a bead into children atomically\n    ///\n    /// Splits a parent bead into the children defined by --children (a JSON\n    /// array of {title, type, priority, ...}), then closes the parent and wires\n    /// the new children to block it — all within a single atomic transaction.\n    Mitosis {\n        /// Parent bead ID to split\n        id: String,\n\n        /// Child bead definitions (JSON array of {title, type, priority})\n        #[arg(long)]\n        children: String,\n\n        /// Close reason for parent bead\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"Split into children\")]\n        reason: String,\n\n        /// Output format (text, json, toon)\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"text\")]\n        format: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Manage dependencies\n    ///\n    /// Subcommands to add, remove, list, or tree dependencies between beads.\n    /// A \"blocks\" dependency marks the blocked bead as Blocked until its\n    /// blocker closes.\n    #[command(subcommand)]\n    Dep(DepCommands),\n\n    /// Manage labels\n    ///\n    /// Subcommands to add, remove, or list labels on beads. Multiple values for\n    /// --status, --type, and --label are OR-combined.\n    Search {\n        /// Search query\n        query: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Filter by status\n        #[arg(short, long)]\n        status: Vec<String>,\n\n        /// Filter by type\n        #[arg(short, long)]\n        type_: Vec<String>,\n\n        /// Filter by assignee\n        #[arg(long)]\n        assignee: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Filter by label\n        #[arg(short, long)]\n        label: Vec<String>,\n\n        /// Filter by minimum priority\n        #[arg(long, value_name = \"MIN\")]\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n\n        /// Filter by maximum priority\n        #[arg(long, value_name = \"MAX\")]\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n\n        /// Limit results\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"50\")]\n        limit: usize,\n\n        /// Output format (text, json, toon)\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"text\")]\n        format: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Show statistics\n    ///\n    /// Summarizes bead counts by status. Add --by-type, --by-priority,\n    /// --by-assignee, or --by-label for the corresponding breakdown.\n    Stats {\n        /// Show breakdown by type\n        #[arg(long)]\n        by_type: bool,\n\n        /// Show breakdown by priority\n        #[arg(long)]\n        by_priority: bool,\n\n        /// Show breakdown by assignee\n        #[arg(long)]\n        by_assignee: bool,\n\n        /// Show breakdown by label\n        #[arg(long)]\n        by_label: bool,\n\n        /// Output format (text, json, toon)\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"text\")]\n        format: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Emit JSON Schema\n    ///\n    /// With \"all\" (default) prints the SQLite DDL for every bf table. With a\n    /// bead ID instead, prints that bead's full JSON representation including\n    /// its annotations.\n    Schema {\n        /// Schema target\n        #[arg(default_value = \"all\")]\n        target: String,\n\n        /// Output format (text, json)\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"json\")]\n        format: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Configuration management\n    ///\n    /// Subcommands to list, get, set, or locate configuration values. Set and\n    /// Get support dot notation for nested keys (e.g. scoring.priority_weight).\n    #[command(subcommand)]\n    Config(ConfigCommands),\n\n    /// Show velocity stats (bead-forge specific)\n    ///\n    /// Reports per-model/harness/type throughput (P50, P90, and average\n    /// seconds) reconstructed from claim-to-close events. Filter with --model\n    /// or --harness. Velocity data accumulates as beads are claimed and closed.\n    Velocity {\n        /// Model\n        #[arg(long)]\n        model: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Harness\n        #[arg(long)]\n        harness: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Output format (text, json, toon)\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"text\")]\n        format: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Manage annotations\n    ///\n    /// Subcommands to set, get, remove, list, or clear annotations — arbitrary\n    /// key/value metadata — on a bead. Beads with\n    /// zero float lie on the critical path; the minimum remaining time is the\n    /// length of that longest chain.\n    CriticalPath {\n        /// Root bead ID\n        id: String,\n\n        /// Maximum depth\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"20\")]\n        max_depth: usize,\n\n        /// Output format (text, json, toon)\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"text\")]\n        format: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Rotate (archive) closed beads older than threshold\n    ///\n    /// Moves closed beads older than --days (default 30) into a timestamped\n    /// archive JSONL file, keeping the active issues.jsonl lean. --dry-run\n    /// previews what would be archived without writing.\n    Rotate {\n        /// Days threshold (archive beads closed this many days ago)\n        #[arg(long, default_value = \"30\")]\n        days: u64,\n\n        /// Dry run (show what would be rotated)\n        #[arg(long)]\n        dry_run: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Migrate workspace from br to bf\n    ///\n    /// Migrates a beads_rust (br) workspace to bead-forge format, with backup\n    /// and verification. --from-jsonl reimports from JSONL for corrupted or\n    /// missing databases; --seed-velocity reconstructs velocity stats from\n    /// events; --dry-run previews without writing.\n    Migrate {\n        /// Workspace path to migrate (defaults to current directory)\n        #[arg(short, long)]\n        workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n\n        /// Reimport from JSONL (for corrupted/missing databases)\n        #[arg(long)]\n        from_jsonl: bool,\n\n        /// Seed velocity stats from reconstructed events\n        #[arg(long)]\n        seed_velocity: bool,\n\n        /// Dry run (show what would be done without making changes)\n        #[arg(long)]\n        dry_run: bool,\n\n        /// Skip verification steps\n        #[arg(long)]\n        skip_verify: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Show recently modified beads\n    ///\n    /// Lists beads ordered by last-updated time. {\n    Ok(Cli::parse())\n}\n\npub fn run(cli: Cli) -> Result<()> {\n    let workspace = cli.workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\".\"));\n\n    // Handle case where no subcommand is provided\n    let command = match cli.command {\n        None => {\n            // clap handles --help automatically, exiting before this point\n            // If we reach here, it means no valid flag was provided\n            return Err(anyhow!(\n                \"No command provided. Use 'bf --help' for usage information.\"\n            ));\n        }\n        Some(cmd) => cmd,\n    };\n\n    // Handle Init command specially (doesn't require existing .beads directory)\n    if let Commands::Init { prefix } = &command {\n        let beads_dir = workspace.join(\".beads\");\n        return cmd_init(&beads_dir, prefix);\n    }\n\n    // Handle MergeJsonl specially: it operates on explicit file paths (as a git\n    // merge driver would) and must not require a discoverable .beads directory.\n    if let Commands::MergeJsonl {\n        base,\n        ours,\n        theirs,\n        output,\n    } = &command\n    {\n        return cmd_merge_jsonl(&workspace, base.as_deref(), ours, theirs, output.as_deref());\n    }\n\n    // All other commands require existing .beads directory\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(&workspace)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace))?;\n\n    match command {\n        Commands::Create {\n            title,\n            type_,\n            priority,\n            description,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n        } => cmd_create(\n            &beads_dir,\n            title,\n            type_,\n            priority,\n            description,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n        ),\n        Commands::List {\n            status,\n            type_,\n            assignee,\n            priority,\n            annotation,\n            limit,\n            all,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_list(\n                &beads_dir, status, type_, assignee, priority, annotation, limit, all, &format,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Show { id, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_show(&beads_dir, &id, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Update {\n            id,\n            title,\n            status,\n            priority,\n            assignee,\n            clear_assignee,\n            description,\n            acceptance_criteria,\n            notes,\n            design,\n            due_at,\n        } => {\n            // --clear-assignee is sugar for --assignee \"\": both flow the\n            // Some(String::new())\n            } else {\n                assignee\n            };\n            cmd_update(\n                &beads_dir,\n                &id,\n                title,\n due_at,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Close { id, reason } => cmd_close(&beads_dir, &id, &reason),\n        Commands::Reopen { id } => cmd_reopen(&beads_dir, &id),\n \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_ready(&beads_dir, limit, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Claim {\n            assignee,\n            model,\n            harness,\n            harness_version,\n            any,\n            fallback,\n            workspace_paths,\n            dry_run,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if harness_version,\n                any,\n                fallback.as_deref(),\n                &workspace_paths,\n                dry_run,\n                &format,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Sync {\n            flush_only,\n            import_only,\n        } => cmd_sync(&beads_dir, flush_only, import_only),\n        // Handled specially before the .beads-directory requirement above.\n        Commands::MergeJsonl { .. } => unreachable!(\"MergeJsonl handled earlier\"),\n        Commands::Doctor {\n            repair,\n            flush_first,\n            force,\n            reclaim_stale,\n            ttl,\n            fix_schema,\n        } => cmd_doctor(\n            &beads_dir,\n            repair,\n            flush_first,\n            force,\n Commands::Log {\n            id,\n            limit,\n            since,\n            actor,\n            status_changes,\n            diff,\n            git,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_log(\n                &beads_dir,\n                id,\n                limit,\n status,\n            type_,\n            assignee,\n            priority,\n            since,\n            before,\n            time_period,\n            limit,\n            format,\n type_,\n                assignee,\n                priority,\n                since,\n                before,\n                time_period,\n                limit,\n                &format,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Init { .. } => unreachable!(\"Init command handled earlier\"),\n    }\n}\n\nfn cmd_init(beads_dir: &PathBuf, prefix: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(beads_dir)?;\n\n    let config_path = beads_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !config_path.exists() {\n        let config = format!(\n            r#\"issue_prefixes: [{}]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n\"#,\n            prefix\n        );\n        std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = std::fs::write(&metadata_path, metadata)?;\n    }\n\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(\"beads.db\");\n    let _storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let gitignore_path = bead-forge workspace in {:?}\", beads_dir);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n\n last_err = None;\n    for _ in 0..5 {\n        id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n        issue.id = id.clone();\n        match storage.create_issue(&issue) {\n            Ok(()) => {\n                created = true;\n                break;\n            }\n            Err(e)\n                if e.to_string()\n                    .contains(\"UNIQUE constraint failed: issues.id\") =>\n            {\n                last_err = Some(e);\n            }\n            Err(e) => return Err(e),\n        }\n    }\n    if !created {\n        return Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.annotations.get(key).map_or(false, |v| v == value));\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let &Path,\n    output: Option<&Path>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Resolve the base: explicit path wins; otherwise fall back to the merge\n    // anchor in the discovered .beads directory. A missing base is not fatal —\n    // merge_jsonl_files degrades to a safe union.\n    let base_path = match base {\n        Some(p) => p.to_path_buf(),\n        None => {\n            let anchor = find_beads_dir(workspace)\n                .map(|bd| crate::merge::base_anchor_path(&bd))\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(crate::merge::BASE_ANCHOR));\n            anchor\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Git driver convention: write the resolved artifact back over \"ours\" (%A).\n    let out_path = output.unwrap_or(ours);\n\n    let report = crate::merge::merge_jsonl_files(&base_path, ours, theirs, out_path)?;\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"Merged {} bead(s): {} added, {} updated, {} deleted, {} conflict(s) auto-resolved\",\n        report.total, report.added, report.updated, report.deleted, report.conflicts\n    );\n\n    // Exit 0 even with auto-resolved conflicts: as a git merge driver, a\n    // zero exit means \"clean merge, use the result\". Common patterns for version output\n87\t\n88\t- **Read from `Cargo.toml`** (most common, zero-maintenance):\n89\t  ```rust\n90\t  #[derive(Parser)]\n91\t  #[command(version, about, long_about = None)]  // version + about pulled from Cargo.toml\n92\t  struct Cli { ... }\n93\t  ```\n94\t- **Propagate to subcommands** so `bf create --version` also works:\n95\t  ```rust\n96\t  #[command(version, propagate_version = true)]\n97\t  ```\n98\t  Without this, only the top-level command gets `--version`.\n99\t- **Custom/multi-line version** (e.g. you want build hash + harness version): disable the built-in flag and add your own:\n100\t  ```rust\n101\t  #[command(disable_version_flag = true)]\n102\t  struct Cli {\n103\t      #[arg(short = 'V', long, action = clap::ArgAction::Version)]\n104\t      version: bool,\n105\t  }\n106\t  // then handle it yourself, or use Cli::command().render_version()\n107\t  ```\n108\t- **`Command::render_version()`** — the builder method that produces the `name version\\n` string if you want to print it yourself (useful when wiring it into a richer version subcommand).\n109\t- **Rich/colored output** — third-party crates like `clap-version-flag` exist precisely because the default is plain text; only reach for these if you want color/banner formatting.\n110\t\n111\t## 5. Relevance to bead-forge\n112\t\n113\t`src/main.rs:4-10` intercepts `--version`/`-V` *before* clap and prints it manually:\n114\t\n115\t```rust\n116\t// Handle version flag before clap parsing to output to stdout\n117\tif args.len() >= 2 && (args[1] == \"--version\" || args[1] == \"-V\") {\n118\t    println!(\"bf {}\", env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\"));\n119\t    std::process::exit(0);\n120\t}\n121\tlet cli = bead_forge::cli::run_cli()?;\n122\t```\n123\t\n124\tThe inline comment implies this was added to *force stdout*. But per this research, **clap already routes `--version` to stdout (exit 0) by default** — it does not go to stderr and does not get an `error:` prefix. So if the manual handler was added to fix a \"version printed to stderr\" or \"Error: prefix\" symptom, that symptom was **not** clap's default behavior. Likely causes of such a symptom elsewhere would be: a typo'd version flag that clap didn't recognize as the version flag (so it became an *unknown argument* parse error → `error:` prefix → stderr), or the version being emitted via an `anyhow`/error path rather than clap's version path.\n125\t\n126\tBecause `#[command(version = env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\"))]` is already set on `Cli`, **removing the manual handler would let clap produce identical `bf 0.3.0` / stdout / exit-0 output natively.** The manual handler is redundant *unless* there's a known reason it's needed (e.g. a subcommand-only parser, or wanting to bypass clap's arg setup cost). Observed:\n\n| Invocation | Stream | Output | Exit |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `--version` | **stdout** (stderr empty) | `bf 0.3.0` | **0** |\n| `-V` | **stdout** | `bf 0.3.0` | **0** |\n| `--bogus` (unknown flag, real error path) | **stderr** | `error: unexpected argument '--bogus' found` | **2** |\n\nThis confirms directly: clap routes `--version`/`-V` to **stdout** with exit **0** and **no** prefix; the `error:` prefix (lowercase) appears **only** on genuine parse failures, which go to **stderr** with exit **2**. There is no capital-`E` `Error:` prefix anywhere in clap.\n\n## 4. Common patterns for version output\n\n- **Read from `Cargo.toml`** (most common, zero-maintenance):\n  ```rust\n  #[derive(Parser)]\n  #[command(version, about, long_about = None)]  // version + about pulled from Cargo.toml\n  struct Cli { ... }\n  ```\n- **Propagate to subcommands** so `bf create --version` also works:\n  ```rust\n  #[command(version, propagate_version = true)]\n  ```\n  Without this, only the top-level command gets `--version`.\n- **Custom/multi-line version** (e.g. you want build hash + harness version): disable the built-in flag and add your own:\n  ```rust\n  #[command(disable_version_flag = true)]\n  struct Cli {\n      #[arg(short = 'V', long, action = clap::ArgAction::Version)]\n      version: bool,\n  }\n  // then handle it yourself, or use Cli::command().render_version()\n  ```\n- **`Command::render_version()`** — the builder method that produces the `name version\\n` string if you want to print it yourself (useful when wiring it into a richer version subcommand).\n- **Rich/colored output** — third-party crates like `clap-version-flag` exist precisely because the default is plain text; only reach for these if you want color/banner formatting.\n\n## 5. Relevance to bead-forge\n\n`src/main.rs:4-10` intercepts `--version`/`-V` *before* clap and prints it manually:\n\n```rust\n// Handle version flag before clap parsing to output to stdout\nif args.len() >= 2 && (args[1] == \"--version\" || args[1] == \"-V\") {\n    println!(\"bf {}\", env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\"));\n    std::process::exit(0);\n}\nlet cli = bead_forge::cli::run_cli()?;\n```\n\nThe inline comment implies this was added to *force stdout*. But per this research, **clap already routes `--version` to stdout (exit 0) by default** — it does not go to stderr and does not get an `error:` prefix. So if the manual handler was added to fix a \"version printed to stderr\" or \"Error: prefix\" symptom, that symptom was **not** clap's default behavior. Likely causes of such a symptom elsewhere would be: a typo'd version flag that clap didn't recognize as the version flag (so it became an *unknown argument* parse error → `error:` prefix → stderr), or the version being emitted via an `anyhow`/error path rather than clap's version path.\n\nBecause `#[command(version = env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\"))]` is already set on `Cli`, **removing the manual handler would let clap produce identical `bf 0.3.0` / stdout / exit-0 output natively.** The manual handler is redundant *unless* there's a known reason it's needed (e.g. a subcommand-only parser, or wanting to bypass clap's arg setup cost). Any follow-up work to simplify this should verify the exact historical motivation before deleting it — flag as a separate task, not done here.\n\n## Sources\n\n- Official clap derive tutorial (v4.6.x): https://docs.rs/clap/latest/clap/_derive/_tutorial/index.html\n- clap crate docs: https://docs.rs/clap\n- clap-version-flag (colored override, shows what the default is *not*): https://crates.io/crates/clap-version-flag\n","numLines":133,"startLine":1,"totalLines":133}}}
